source: Provincial Department of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries, Pursat Province — សារធាតុចិញ្ចឹមសម្រាប់ដំណាំស្រូវ (Nutrients for the Rice Crop), presenter Yem Sophy, 20 Nov 2017, p.2
text: Fertilizer (ជី) is defined as material that must be added to the soil in order to increase crop productivity, or to supplement soil nutrients that are deficient relative to what the crop needs at a given stage.
